# `<compiler.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Branch and placement hints shared by the kernel and userspace.

```c
#include <compiler.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="likely"></a>`likely(x)` |  | Hints that `x` is usually true, so the compiler lays out that path as the fall-through. |
| <a id="unlikely"></a>`unlikely(x)` |  | Hints that `x` is usually false, moving that path out of line. |
